examples.arabic: كل حاجة حواليه كانت بتفتح باب لسؤال جديد في دماغ الولد الشاطر ده
examples.english: Everything around him was opening a door to a new question in the mind of this clever boy.
examples.transliteration: Kol haga hawalieh kanet betfatah bab le so2al gedeed fe demagh el-walad el-shater dah.

examples.arabic: سيف طفل شاطر بس بيسأل كتير قوي كل يوم
examples.english: Seif is a clever child but he asks a lot of questions every day.
examples.transliteration: Seif tifl shater bas biyes'al keteer awi kol yom

examples.english: Papa is happy and says Ali is clever.
examples.transliteration: Baba sa'eed wa biy'ool Ali shater

examples.arabic: شربت الشاي وحسيت اني شاطر اوي وعايز اجري
examples.english: I drank the tea and felt very clever and wanted to run
examples.transliteration: Sheribt el shay w hassayt enni shater awi w 'ayez agry
